source.title: Coptic Orthodox Katameros · citation-only calendar snapshot
source.note: Appointments only. No Bible translation, prayer text or Synaxarium text is imported. The snapshot follows this upstream implementation; local church exceptions take precedence.

issues.Eph 2:1-23: The upstream citation ends at verse 23; this chapter has 22 verses. Check your church calendar.
issues.Ps 101:1,9: Verse 9 does not exist in Psalm 101 in the stated English numbering. Check the Psalm and verse numbering in your church calendar.
issues.Ezek 21:33-37: This citation uses a different chapter division from the bundled Bibles. Check your church calendar; no verse mapping is assumed.
